resources.string: For developers • One tap • No OCR
Copy accessible screen text, including terminal commands and logs, with one tap. No OCR or INTERNET permission.

Apps installed outside Google Play may show a restricted settings warning. If the option is available on your device:
1. Tap App info below.
2. Open the three-dot menu (⋮) in the upper-right corner.
3. Choose Allow restricted settings and confirm with your PIN or biometrics.
